sentences.span: The FOMC raised the fed funds rate by 25bps to 3.75-4.00% as expected, with the unanimous decision
sentences.why: Confirmed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%, unanimous. First-since-2023 confirmed in 16686 ("marking the first hike since July 2023").

sentences.span: a 16-2 majority projected at least one more hike this year, with four participants projecting two more hikes this year ... There were no dissenting votes
sentences.why: 16 of 18 / four expecting two / no dissents all match. Goldman's own prior expectation that Waller would dissent is in 16593/16597 ("We expect Governor Waller to dissent").

sentences.span: Warsh's comments, who said both he and his colleagues were "hard-pressed" to describe policy as restrictive
sentences.why: Exact match for the quote, plus "dose of accommodation" corroborated in the same file and 16682/16688.

sentences.span: Market pricing of the probability of further hikes this year rose 8pp to 51% for October and 9pp to 78% for December today, with particularly strong reactions to the release of the dots
sentences.why: GS notes the market repriced sharply on the dots and that "our probability-weighted Fed forecast remains less hawkish than market pricing" -- market treated the projections as the likely path.

sentences.span: median-longer run dot was revised up from 3.06% to 3.25% ... unemployment rate forecasts also became more optimistic, this year revised down to 4.1%—a tenth under their estimate of the natural rate of unemployment
sentences.why: Both figures (3.25% neutral, 4.1% unemployment, a tenth below natural-rate estimate) match exactly; corroborated in 16688.

Ultimately we need to see sentiment become less complacent, more oversold conditions, and a higher-correlation index decline for us to think this correction has run its course.

sentences.span: the S&P 500's Software Index rallied 3.2%, whereas the Semiconductor Index fell 4.4%
sentences.why: Exact match; source is Raymond James ("Up and Adam", meta.json source field).

sentences.span: Anthropic CEO Amodei's comments triggered the largest one-day move in the +Software / -Semis pair (JPPQSFSM Index) in its history, +12%
sentences.why: Exact match; JPPQSFSM is a JPMorgan index, and Amodei's underlying comment (source-text-all/2026-09-17/16678) explicitly calls to "slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models."

The claim only appears in derived card files (16549.json, 16559.json), which are not source evidence per the grading procedure.

sentences.span: Mean time to exploit has collapsed, in some cases inflecting negative as adversaries weaponize vulnerabilities before patches exist.
sentences.why: The directional claim (mean time to exploit collapsing/negative) is a real JPMorgan claim, but no source document anywhere in the set gives the specific figures asserted (-7 days in 2025, 63 days in 2018, 132 new vulnerabilities/day, 16% fixed per month) -- these precise stats are fabricated additions to a real qualitative claim.

sentences.span: Driven by inflation fears as Brent crude surged past $109/bbl ... money markets aggressively repriced rate expectations ... Gold also plunged over 2%, slipping below $4,300/oz.
sentences.why: Both the gold move and the oil-driven-inflation-scare-firms-hike-odds causal chain are directly stated.

sentences.span: Into the Fed, GS favors cheap upside convexity. Call skew and risk reversals are not pricing much upside tail risk, while GLD gamma could amplify the move.
sentences.why: "GLD gamma"/"gamma pockets on GLD" (also in 16597) is a fair translation of concentrated dealer positioning in GLD options; the skew/risk-reversal claim is verbatim.
